name: Terrible vacation
text: If a shark ate you, would it poop out your bones? First of all... terrible vacation. But don't picture a tiny skeleton coming out the other end.

name: Digestion and the return route
text: A shark's digestive system can break down bone. Large pieces that don't break down may stay in the stomach and get vomited back out.

name: Wrong exit
text: Yes. Wrong exit. And here's where it gets ridiculous.

name: Stomach eversion
text: Some sharks can push their stomach out through their mouth, get rid of unwanted material, then pull it back inside.

name: Difficult lunch
text: Imagine turning your stomach inside out because lunch was being difficult.

name: No guaranteed destination
text: So your bones don't have one guaranteed destination. Some can break down. Stubborn pieces may get returned to sender.

name: Customer service
text: Congratulations. You weren't just lunch. You were a customer service issue.
